run_rerank: run the rerank function to rescore n-best translation hypotheses and select the best ones
run_cli_main: run the CLI entry point to parse arguments and execute the reranking pipeline
run_score_target_hypo: run score_target_hypo to compute BLEU scores for hypotheses with configurable weights and length penalty
run_match_target_hypo: run match_target_hypo to combine LM and bitext scores and write the top scoring hypothesis
run_load_score_files: run load_score_files to load precomputed scoring results from multiple shards for rescoring
